title: Package bytes for transport
responsibility: Encodes bytes for transport with their length, media type and SHA-256 hash.

inputs.name: binaryAnswer.bytes
inputs.description: The byte sequence encoded for transport. Its length, SHA-256 digest and base64 payload are derived directly from it; this function applies no explicit size check.

inputs.name: binaryAnswer.mediaType
inputs.description: The string label copied into the answer; when omitted, it is image/png. This function does not validate the label against the bytes.

outputs.name: binaryAnswer
outputs.description: The transport record returned from the call, with base64 encoding, the supplied media type, byte count, SHA-256 hex digest and base64 payload. The media type is copied as given or defaults to image/png, and the function does not validate it against the bytes.
